title: kbmon's needs-you line and sprint panel show each item's run state and a blocked item's gate on its work branch
goal: kbmon reads the coord run keys of the clone's store beside the item files: the needs-you line names each item whose run state is blocked with its gate ids (an entry an operator acts on, so it names the item id), each failed run and each landing refused, with the step that stopped it; the sprint panel's rows carry each open item's run state and its age, and kbmon.py --status all and --status sprints give the same, so a gate committed on a worker's work branch shows before the worker returns

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Planted', '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
def plant(status):
    for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
        d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
        if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
        if d['id'] == iid: d['status'] = status; d['sprint'] = sp
        json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
    g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted ' + status)
def walk(*states): return [c('transition', 'run/' + iid, '--to', s).returncode for s in states]
plant('doing')
walk('claimed', 'working')
wt = os.path.join(T, '.claude', 'worktrees', 'agent-' + iid)
g('worktree', 'add', '-q', wt, '-b', 'work/' + iid)
gate = subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', wt, 'gate', 'add', iid, '--question', 'Which default?',
                       '--option', 'a', '--option', 'b', '--recommendation', 'a'], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, cwd=wt)
subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', 'commit', '-qam', 'gate on the work branch'], cwd=wt, env=env)
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/kbmon.py', '--status', 'all', '--json', '--root', T, '--store', S],
                   capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
try:
    first = json.loads(r.stdout)['lines'][0]
except (ValueError, KeyError, IndexError):
    first = ''
ok = gate.returncode == 0 and r.returncode == 0 and iid in first and 'g1' in first
print('gate on branch', gate.returncode, '| needs line:', first[:160])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Premise: in a planted clone with a blocking gate committed on the worker's work/<id> branch, kbmon.py --status all --json gives the needs-you line 'needs you: SP-... gate start': the branch gate is invisible, since the sprint panel reads the item files of origin/main or the checkout only (kb/_self/monitoring.md:97,202). The kbmon-pane mod's terminal notification on a needs-you change is a later story of this epic (epic notes).
